56450846b46ac0d9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ورثة الدكتور محمد البادي الطبية لمستشفيات الزهراء وصيدل عن أخصائي تقنية إشعاعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية إجراء التصوير الإشعاعي للمرضى، وضمان جودة الصور، والالتزام بمعايير السلامة. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد المرضى للتصوير وتهيئتهم وفق الأوضاع السليمة، وتحديد واختيار الوسائل الواقية المناسبة. تفقد وتشغيل أجهزة التصوير الشعاعي، وتصوير الحالات المختلفة للمرضى والمصابين، مع مراقبة حالتهم أثناء وبعد التصوير. تفقد وتجهيز أجهزة التحميض، ومراجعة الصور، وإجراء التحليل الأولي لضمان جودة التصوير. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات الحديثة في تقنيات التصوير بالأشعة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتصوير الإشعاعي، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بجميع أعمال التصوير بالأشعة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال تقنية الإشعاع. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق طبي. بيئة العمل يقع مكان العمل في المدينة المنورة، ويوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ضمن مستشفيات الزهراء وصيدل. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب الالتزام بتقديم رعاية صحية عالية الجودة. التقديم لم يتم الكشف عن الراتب لهذه الوظيفة. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة للتقديم.

564772a8641ae0c7.description: About Decima International Decima International is a professional services company specializing in project management and controls services. The company serves clients across the United States and the Middle East, with a mission to be a premier professional services provider across all engaged industry sectors. This is achieved by approaching each client engagement as a partnership, fostering an environment that attracts talented professionals, and regulating growth to maintain excellence in service standards. The Role: Procurement Engineer Decima International is seeking a Procurement Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on supporting procurement activities for major construction, infrastructure, and engineering projects. The Procurement Engineer will be instrumental in developing and implementing procurement strategies and ensuring compliance with project requirements. Key Responsibilities Support the development and implementation of project procurement strategies and plans. Coordinate the procurement of major equipment, materials, systems, and subcontracted packages. Distinguish and track Owner-Furnished Contractor-Installed (OFCI) and Contractor-Furnished Contractor-Installed (CFCI) scope. Prepare and review RFQs, RFPs, tender documentation, and procurement packages. Coordinate with engineering and design teams to ensure procurement packages comply with technical specifications. Support technical and commercial bid evaluations and prepare comparison reports. Review vendor and contractor technical and commercial proposals. Support vendor prequalification, evaluation, selection, and negotiations, and prepare award recommendations. Perform expediting, delivery tracking, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) coordination. Monitor procurement schedules and long-lead equipment against the approved project schedule. Maintain long-lead equipment trackers covering procurement milestones, manufacturing, FAT, shipping, and site delivery. Coordinate delivery dates with contractors and vendors, ensuring alignment with site readiness and installation sequencing. Facilitate periodic long-lead equipment coordination meetings and follow up on actions, risks, and logistics constraints. Track vendor submittals, technical approvals, manufacturing status, and delivery milestones. Align vendor submittal review and approval cycles with procurement schedules and commissioning stage gates. Monitor purchase orders and vendor performance. Coordinate Factory Acceptance Testing and equipment inspections, including scheduling and witness attendance. Coordinate shipping, customs clearance, and site logistics with logistics providers and contractors. Identify procurement delays, supply-chain constraints, and risks, and recommend mitigation actions. Coordinate with various project teams including contractors, vendors, logistics, construction, commissioning, and project controls. Participate in vendor meetings, progress reviews, and factory coordination meetings. Support procurement-related variations, change orders, and claims. Maintain procurement trackers, status reports, and supporting documentation within the project EDMS / PMIS. Prepare regular procurement progress reports highlighting risks, delays, critical items, and required actions. Coordinate handover of vendor documentation into the project EDMS, ensuring availability for commissioning and closeout. Escalate matters exceeding delegated authority to the Procurement / Tendering Lead and Project / Site Director. Ensure procurement activities comply with project procedures, contractual requirements, and applicable governance. Handle sensitive commercial, pricing, and vendor information confidentially. Qualifications and Experience Required: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Required: 3–5 years of procurement experience on construction, infrastructure, or major engineering projects. Required: Experience procuring major equipment, materials, and long-lead packages. Required: Strong understanding of technical procurement and tendering processes. Required: Experience preparing and reviewing RFQs, RFPs, tender documentation, and procurement packages. Required: Experience conducting technical and commercial bid evaluations and preparing comparison reports. Required: Knowledge of vendor prequalification, evaluation, selection, and procurement recommendations. Required: Experience managing procurement schedules and long-lead equipment trackers. Required: Understanding of OFCI and CFCI procurement arrangements. Required: Experience with purchase order tracking, expediting, and vendor performance monitoring. Required: Knowledge of general procurement guidelines and relevant laws and regulations. Required: Knowledge of logistics and delivery coordination, including Incoterms, shipping, and customs clearance. Required: Experience coordinating Factory Acceptance Testing and equipment inspections. Required: Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, datasheets, and drawings. Required: Strong procurement reporting skills. Required: Good negotiation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills. Required: Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in Word and PowerPoint. Required: Experience with ERP or procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, or equivalent. Required: Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft clear technical and commercial correspondence. Preferred: Experience on data center, hyperscale, mission-critical, or industrial projects. Preferred: Experience procuring mission-critical long-lead equipment (*, Switchgear, Transformers, Generators, UPS systems, Chillers, CRAH / CRAC units, BMS / EPMS systems). Preferred: Experience within a PMC, consultant, or Owner's Representative environment. Preferred: Knowledge of FIDIC or similar construction contracts. Preferred: Knowledge of KSA and GCC procurement practices and local vendor markets. Preferred: Understanding of Saudi local content requirements. Preferred: CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent procurement certification. Preferred: Experience with international suppliers, OEMs, and regional logistics providers. Preferred: Familiarity with electronic document management and project management information systems. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time Procurement Engineer position in Riyadh. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

568987d55dd5f12f.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Sr. Materials and Corrosion Engineer to join the Offshore team in Al Khobar, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is critical for ensuring asset integrity and longevity through specialized expertise in materials selection, corrosion prevention, and assessment. The role requires a strong technical foundation to guide decision-making and ensure compliance with Aramco and industry standards. Key Responsibilities Lead Brownfield and Greenfield Offshore Projects, acting as a technical focal point for all aspects of materials engineering, and managing project bids, execution, resources, and deliverables. Develop Corrosion Management Programs, Material Selection Reports, Material Selection Diagrams, Coating Selection Diagrams, and Corrosion Loop Diagrams. Carry out corrosion assessments on pipelines, piping, and equipment, with a preference for software experience with ECE-5. Conduct Non-metallic Material Studies, including the development of non-metallic material assessments and material selection of appropriate non-metallic material. Provide technical support for disciplines and project-related tasks and workshops, including OSI, RBI, and Corrosion Inspection Manuals for operating assets and new projects. Develop and resolve Technical Queries, review and approve materials substitutions, and resolve site fabrication issues. Lead engineering assessments based on applicable codes such as API 579, BS DNV RP F101, ASME ******, ISO 15156, ISO 21457. Review Technical Bid Evaluations (TBEs) and Non-Material Requirements (NMRs), primarily related to the materials scope. Review integrity assessment reports, which may include ILI reports, Fitness for Purpose (FFP) / Recommendations for Repair Reports (RRR), ILI raw data, and Direct Assessment reports as primary input. Assist in the training and development of junior team members. Liaise with global offices for support where needed. Conduct site visits outside offices as and when required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in materials and corrosion engineering. Demonstrated expertise in materials selection, corrosion prevention, and assessment. Proficiency in relevant industry standards and codes, including API 579, BS DNV RP F101, ASME ******, ISO 15156, and ISO 21457. Experience with Aramco standards is required. Technical Skills Strong technical foundation in materials engineering and corrosion management. Ability to develop and implement corrosion management programs and material selection documentation. Experience with corrosion assessment software, preferably ECE-5. Capability to conduct non-metallic material studies and assessments. Work Environment This role is based in Al Khobar, Saudi Arabia, and is part of the Offshore team. The position may require site visits outside the office as needed. Application Process Candidates interested in this Sr. Materials and Corrosion Engineer position are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

56d7bc5a977cc4cb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التوزيع الحديث للتجارة عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة دورة المبيعات الكاملة، بدءًا من بناء علاقات العملاء وحتى تحصيل الديون، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. ملخص الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات، وإنشاء قاعدة بيانات للعملاء، والتواصل معهم لتقديم عروض البيع وإتمام الصفقات. كما يشمل الدور متابعة العملاء وتحصيل الديون، وإعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو المكالمات لترويج المنتجات (السلع والخدمات) وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية بالشركة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة جازان، وهو دور بدوام كامل يتطلب التواجد الميداني والتفاعل المباشر مع العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

56f51edfb8b4d15a.description: About the Role Kafou Energy is seeking an experienced BMS Project Testing & Commissioning Engineer to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role is central to the delivery of high-quality Building Management System (BMS) projects, focusing on the execution of testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of BMS systems. Role Overview The BMS Project Testing & Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for the comprehensive testing and commissioning of BMS systems. This includes verifying field devices, controllers, networks, and system integrations. The role ensures that all systems comply with project specifications and supports overall system optimization and issue resolution. Key Responsibilities Execute testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of BMS systems. Verify field devices, controllers, networks, and system integrations. Conduct functional performance testing and ensure compliance with project specifications. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, subcontractors, and clients during commissioning activities. Prepare commissioning reports, test documentation, and handover packages. Support site activities, system optimization, and issue resolution. Qualifications and Experience Previous experience in BMS testing and commissioning. A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience is required. Required Skills Strong knowledge of HVAC controls and BMS platforms. Proficiency in communication protocols and troubleshooting techniques. Ability to interpret technical drawings. Good teamwork and communication skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within a growing team focused on energy solutions.

562920102e1e032b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زمام القوة للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC) لضمان الأداء الأمثل لهذه المعدات الحيوية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة التشغيل. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف، للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء (HVAC). فهم قوي لمبادئ تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة HVAC. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة، المملكة العربية السعودية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان جودة وكفاءة أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف في مختلف المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

568f6b54f2926385.job_title: Associate / Associate Director Building Technology Systems
568f6b54f2926385.description: About the Role WSP Middle East is seeking an Associate / Associate Director for Building Technology Systems to join its growing BTS team within the Property & Buildings business unit in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves supporting the delivery of smart building solutions, ICT design, ELV systems, and Creative AV technology for high-profile projects across the region. Conduct site inspections, review technical submittals, and support testing and commissioning activities. 5691feb8ef680276.description: About the Role Catrion is seeking an Asst. Manager Food Development to join their team in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, covering the cities of Umluj and Tabuk. This full-time role is central to the development and implementation of menus, recipes, and food design, ensuring alignment with target costs and high-quality standards. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage menus, including uploading them to the catering platform. Collaborate with procurement and finance teams to achieve food cost targets. Monitor recipe and routing compliance, addressing anomalies and reporting to the Commercial Manager. Train chefs on correct cooking methods for new products introduced into the factory. Lead training for third-party staff at customer canteens to ensure proper food reheating and preparation. Develop and maintain product specifications, including photographic standards and production guides. Introduce tools for chefs to measure applicable attributes such as thickness, pH levels, salt, sugar, spice, and product coloring. Conduct internal and third-party sensory evaluations. Manage the scaling up of products from kitchen trials to full-scale factory production. Conduct market research on new food trends and products in coordination with the Procurement department. Support internal customers during tender processes. Develop new and innovative packaging to enhance product appearance. Assist in streamlining raw materials to reduce wastage and improve forecasts. Conduct menu presentations in coordination with the sales department. Write recipes and procedures for new products or reformulate existing ones. Work with the production and menu planning team to ensure successful delivery and start-ups of new products, product improvements, cost reductions, and changes in ingredients, formulas, specifications, and processes. Document all work processes according to established procedures and guidelines. Prepare or assist in preparing project reports and plans for the Executive Chef of Menu Planning to ensure clear communication of project status, progress, solutions, timelines, and accountability. Financial and Strategic Support Participate with the Commercial Manager in periodic reviews and planning. Support the Commercial Manager in compiling statistics and figures for internal customers for annual turnover budget preparation. Assist the Commercial Manager in preparing the business plan and budget write-up. Ensure operating expenses remain within budget limits. 56b5d97b2fc984c8.description: المسمى الوظيفي: بائع الهدف من الوظيفة: دعم العمليات اليومية وتحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء داخل المعرض، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على النظافة العامة والمظهر الجيد وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة والحفاظ على روح التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق. المساهمة في رفع مبيعات الفرع من خلال متابعة تحقيق الأهداف الشهرية ومقارنتها بالفترة نفسها من العام السابق. الالتزام بساعات العمل الرسمية وبلبس الزي الموحد المعتمد من الشركة. المحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم المعرض في جميع الأوقات. ضمان عدم وجود مخالفات حكومية من خلال الالتزام بجميع التعليمات التشغيلية. متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على تقليلها من خلال تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل فعال ومهارات البيع الالتزام، حسن المظهر وروح الفريق أيام العمل : 6 أيام في الاسبوع الإجازة الاسبوعية: يوم واحد (تكون الإجازة في وسط الاسبوع وليس في الويكيند) العمل بدوام كامل (8 ساعات) (يتم التعيين على شفت واحد سواء مسائي أو صباحي) ☀️ الشفت الصباحي 9 الصباح - 5 المساء 🌙الشفت المسائي 4 مساء - 12 منتصف الليل يمكن أن يتم التنقل بين الفروع القريبة هذه الوظيفة تتطلب استخراج بطاقة صحية (شهادة صحية) بعد التعيين

56ce9ebaa279abf3.description: About the Role Wipro is seeking an Oracle FAH Techno Functional Consultant to join our team in Riyadh. 56e0ea19ecc04356.description: About the Role Sadim For Real Estate Development is seeking a Real Estate Content Creator to join their team in Makkah, with work locations in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role is responsible for developing high-quality visual and digital content that highlights the company's real estate projects, properties, brand, and activities across various social media and digital platforms. The position requires 2-5 years of experience and combines real estate photography, videography, video editing, creative content production, and social media content management to establish a strong digital presence. Key Responsibilities Develop and produce engaging photo and video content for real estate projects, properties, and company activities. Visit project sites and properties to capture professional photography and videography. Create short-form content, including Reels, TikTok videos, Stories, property tours, project showcases, and promotional videos. Develop creative concepts and storyboards suitable for different social media platforms. Capture high-quality footage that highlights property features, architecture, interiors, locations, and project progress. Ensure all content reflects the company's brand identity and professional standards. Photography and Videography Conduct professional real estate photography and videography on-site. Operate cameras, lenses, lighting, microphones, gimbals, and other production equipment. Plan and execute property shoots based on project requirements. Coordinate with internal teams and project representatives during filming. Ensure proper framing, composition, lighting, sound, and overall visual quality. Perform video cutting, transitions, color correction, audio editing, subtitles, and basic motion graphics. Adapt content into different formats and specifications for various platforms, including Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Snapchat. Maintain organized libraries of raw footage, edited content, photos, and project assets. Social Media and Brand Standards Plan and prepare content according to the company's social media calendar. Create platform-specific content based on audience and channel requirements. Stay updated with social media trends, formats, sounds, and creative approaches relevant to the real estate industry. Collaborate with the Marketing and Sales teams to develop content that supports brand awareness and sales objectives. Monitor content performance and provide recommendations for improving engagement and reach. Maintain consistency in the company's visual identity across all content and ensure all published content meets quality and branding standards. Contribute creative ideas for campaigns, property launches, events, and corporate content. Continuously explore new photography, videography, editing, and content-production techniques. Demonstrated creativity and a visually driven approach to content production. Proficiency in handling production equipment, including cameras, lenses, lighting, microphones, and gimbals. The Group has 65 years of experience contributing to urban and regional development by creating, improving, and modernizing infrastructure and transport systems across project lifecycles, from design to deployment and maintenance. SYSTRA operates in over 80 countries, generating 74% of its turnover internationally, and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. This role serves as the primary contact for payroll and technical support for HR team members, leaders, and employees regarding HRIS platforms. The incumbent is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with local Labour Law regulations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience, strong attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills, and proficiency in HRIS software applications. Identify and resolve potential HRIS system issues in partnership with the SYSTRA IT team and external vendors. Implement and manage SYSTRA’s new HRIS platform. Maintain expert knowledge of SYSTRA’s HRIS platforms and act as the expert user/administrator. Analyze HRIS data to generate insights on employee performance and key HR metrics. Create reports and dashboards to provide leaders with analytical insights and identify issues for HR management to address. Manage the KSA payroll administration process. Administer the annual Global People Survey and spot surveys as applicable. Stay updated on local Labour Laws and regulations, ensuring HRIS systems comply with changes. Monitor technological advancements and trends in HRIS. Collaborate with HR professionals to improve HR processes and systems for increased efficiency. Manage access to HRIS systems, ensuring the confidentiality and security of employee information. Educate and train employees on HRIS system usage and provide ongoing support. Required Skills and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Strong attention to detail. Analytical and problem-solving skills. Proficiency in HRIS software applications. Ability to keep abreast of changes in applicable platform offerings. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company, and this position is open to all qualified applicants.

567511557898ec91.description: The Project Manager’s role is essential in ensuring the successful delivery of projects. The role holder will lead the implementation of small to large projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams and a range of internal and external stakeholders. This role will deploy the full range of the department’s tools and processes to ensure the successful design and deployment and delivery of all assigned projects throughout their full lifecycles with a strong focus on achieving the intended benefits and operational performance goals. General Responsibilities Manage and execute projects under the guidance of the Senior Project Manager and the Project Delivery Lead Management to ensure they are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with predefined and agreed objectives and quality standards. Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, and budgets. Continuously monitor project progress, identifying and addressing issues, risks and changes as they arise. Work with the Director Project Delivery Lead Management to define project milestones/objectives and deliverables for projects and establish a framework for monitoring and reporting project performance. Collaborate with project team members to identify and implement improvement strategies that enhance project delivery efficiency and effectiveness and mitigate issues and risks. Work closely with various departments within the Centre of Excellence (COE) to ensure seamless coordination and alignment of project activities with overall business objectives. Foster effective communication and collaboration among project team members and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned with project goals, objectives and the status of all assigned projects. Implement and uphold rigorous quality assurance processes to ensure that projects meet or exceed quality standards and customer expectations. Conduct regular project audits to verify adherence to established quality guidelines and identify areas for improvement. Identify potential project issues, risks, changes and collaborate within the Project Delivery Teams to develop contingency and mitigation plans to proactively address challenges that may impact project delivery. Allocate and manage project resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, and equipment, to optimize project delivery and ensure the efficient utilization of resources. Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project plans, progress reports, all project logs and documentation of lessons learned, in line with organizational standards. Provide regular updates and reports on project status to the Director Project Delivery Lead Management, Chief Operational Excellence Officer, and relevant stakeholders. Recommend training and development interventions for team members to build their capabilities. Contribute to the identification of opportunities for the continuous improvement of systems, processes, and practices to increase productivity and operational efficiency. Implement all relevant Department’s policies, processes, procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner. Contribute to the preparation of timely and accurate reports to meet departmental requirements, policies, and standards. Qualification Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required. Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred. PMP or Prince2 certification is required. Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written business English. 7+ years of experience in project management or a related field preferably into Supplychain industries, including planning, execution, delivery, and reporting. Proven experience in project management, including planning, execution, delivery, reporting and effective communication. Experience working with leadership and senior stakeholders and coordinating across internal cross-functional teams. Experience with any one of PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, or structured reporting and governance. Broader experience across PMP-style project controls, Prince2, risk and change management, and structured reporting and governance is preferred. Experience in logistics and supply chain projects is preferred.

567f8da6c1437d49.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work - not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised. This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal - not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction. If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well - this role is for you. What You Will Do Own delivery from pre-RFP to go-live. Lead pre-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made. Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery - with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle. Ensure every project proposal goes through cross-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door. Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness. Run governance like it matters - because it does. Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision-making checkpoints. Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks. Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility - not a sanitised summary. Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made. Run post-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation. Keep every part of the business aligned. Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery. Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings - and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read. Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements. Manage third-party and vendor risk. Oversee vendor and third-party onboarding governance - tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project. Maintain a Third-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities. Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners. Bring the same rigour to internal programmes. Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives - process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes. Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership. Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use. You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises. Who You Are You have 5+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice. You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them. You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise. You have real financial acumen - cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off. You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done. Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience - whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO. You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically - the framework serves the project, not the other way around. You are comfortable in a fast-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go. Culturally, you are: Structured but not rigid. Proactive, not reactive. Calm when it gets complicated - and it will get complicated. Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. What the Hiring Process Will Look Like Screening call with Talent Acquisition Deep-dive interview with the Head of Services Case study presentation - project governance and risk scenario Offer
